scope: Fresh five-seed validation of the preregistered continuation candidate across all 19 origins, with fixed workload policies and execution/resource ceilings.
measurement_notes: All 190 registered cells are retained; no validation seed or failed origin was removed or retuned.
The control uses main search mechanisms within the same build and imported adapter policies, not a historical main executable with different adapters.
Time-to-victory medians are conditional on success; paired ratios use only seeds solved in both arms and must be read with gained/lost solves.
Three concurrent eight-worker jobs occupy disjoint CPU sets. This is a quality panel; use isolated throughput trials for precise speed claims.
Output disk excludes shared assets/builds and runtime temporary files outside the cell directory. OS RSS, logical memory, and process I/O are separate.
Nova later-level origins include prior cleared flags as declared setup, not new search achievements. Whole-game origin requires all 40 flags.
Metroid area milestones are bitsets; tanks combine missile-capacity/5 and energy tanks. Aggregate milestones may combine branches; verified witness milestones are separate.
Metroid 50-million-frame rows are sampled diagnostics, not an additional tuned objective; reached_50m_frames identifies runs that actually reach that work threshold.
